contentJudgment: A coherent, readable condensation of the real four-step system. It retains the authors’ experiments, joy, imperfect use, real examples and flexible routines. Two small communication-procedure passages need source qualifications restored in both languages; no wholesale rewrite, count change or deletion of practical procedures is requested. Essential’s 19-screen argument is intact. The required corrections affect Core and Deep.

requiredFindings.category: Removed qualification in an actual author procedure

wording.ru: Тактика 19 отключает эти сигналы: теперь проверку начинает сам пользователь.
wording.en: Tactic 19 turns those signals off so that the user initiates checking.

requiredFindings.problem: The paragraph presents turning off notifications without the author’s operational exception. Tactic 19 says almost all, explicitly keeps genuinely useful/important signals such as calendar reminders, and preserves a single urgent channel such as SMS. This is part of the actual procedure, not an outside safety disclaimer. As written, the summary changes selective control into undifferentiated silence.

minimalCorrection.ru: Заменить эту фразу на: «Тактика 19 предлагает отключить почти все уведомления, сохранив действительно полезные — например, календарные напоминания и один срочный канал вроде SMS. Остальные сервисы проверяет сам пользователь». Следующую фразу о выходе из аккаунта можно оставить.
minimalCorrection.en: Replace the sentence with: “Tactic 19 turns off almost all notifications while retaining genuinely useful ones, such as calendar reminders and one urgent channel like SMS. The user chooses when to check the other services.” Keep the sign-out paragraph.

requiredFindings.sourceLocator: Owned RU EPUB, OEBPS/Text/content2.2.html, tactic 19 «Отключите уведомления»: the list immediately after the paragraph beginning «Уведомления вам не друзья»; list items 2–3 preserve useful alerts and one urgent route.

requiredFindings.category: Qualification lost; optional announcement made categorical

wording.ru: Границу связи нужно объяснить, иначе её будут угадывать / Тактика 39 прямо сообщает людям, когда ожидать ответа… Необъявленное замедление может выглядеть как игнорирование…
wording.en: Explain communication boundaries instead of making people guess / Tactic 39 tells people when to expect a reply… Unannounced delay may look like neglect…

requiredFindings.problem: The source presents explicit explanation as one option, then uses the authors’ own Google Ventures practice to say that sometimes no explicit announcement is necessary: colleagues inferred their slower email pattern. It also expressly exempts jobs such as sales/customer support that require rapid replies. The summary substitutes a categorical disclosure rule and omits the applicability boundary. Both matter in a practical condensation.

minimalCorrection.ru: Смягчить заголовок, например «Согласовать ожидания ответа». Сохранить предложение объяснить срок ответа и срочный канал; заменить заключительные обобщения двумя оговорками: «Иногда отдельного объявления не требуется: коллеги авторов сами привыкли к их режиму. Продажи и поддержка, однако, могут требовать быстрых ответов».
minimalCorrection.en: Use a noncategorical title, for example “Adjust expectations about replies.” Retain explaining response times and an urgent channel as an option; replace the concluding generalizations with: “Sometimes no announcement is needed: the authors’ colleagues learned their pattern from experience. Sales and customer support, however, may require fast replies.”

requiredFindings.sourceLocator: Owned RU EPUB, OEBPS/Text/content2.6.html, tactic 39 «Измените характер коммуникативных ожиданий»: paragraphs beginning «Иногда вам даже не нужно давать такое объяснение в явном виде» and «Правда, некоторые профессии». In the reviewer’s nonempty h1–h4/p block count these are 25–26.

materialLimitations: Checked primary arguments and the selected procedures/cases at their actual source sections, not all 87 tactics and references continuously. Full-edition availability is not full-book reading.
No full English edition consulted; both delivered languages read, with EN checked against RU meaning and the supplied Russian primary edition.
No independent clinical/productivity efficacy validation; verdict is about fidelity, appropriate attribution and reading experience.
No root/publication or browser/device certification. Publisher must rebuild/recheck hashes after any corrections.
